provenance: scripts/mark_landmarks.py, 2026-10-14, anny 0.6.1, template body male 178 cm 75 kg

rules.c7: back midline vertex closest in height to the neck01 bone head (base of the neck)
rules.acromion.L: highest vertex within 5 cm (horizontally) of the left shoulder joint
rules.acromion.R: highest vertex within 5 cm (horizontally) of the right shoulder joint
rules.armpit.L: torso-side point where a horizontal section, scanned down from the shoulder joint, first loses the left arm (its width drops by 3 cm)
rules.waist_front: front-most vertex of Anny's own waist ring (anny.anthropometry)
rules.hip_back: back-most point of the torso section with the largest girth between the crotch and the waist
rules.crotch: lowest midline vertex above the knees
rules.elbow.L: back-most vertex within 5 cm of the left elbow joint
rules.elbow.R: back-most vertex within 5 cm of the right elbow joint
rules.knee.L: front-most vertex within 6 cm of the left knee joint
rules.knee.R: front-most vertex within 6 cm of the right knee joint
